_comment: MANUALLY MAINTAINED — see frontend-react/README.md for the update process. Seeds Community Pulse Next Meetings until the Village publishes a machine-readable calendar. Regular schedule: Planning, Zoning & Design Board meets mid-month (often 3rd Tuesday) at 4:30 PM; Village Council meets twice monthly (often 1st/3rd Wednesday, with summer/holiday shifts) at 9:30 AM. Both at Estero Village Hall, 9401 Corkscrew Palms Circle. Update monthly — drop past dates, skip cancellations, add the next occurrence(s). Verify against https://estero-fl.gov/meetings/ and https://esterotoday.com/village-county-meetings/ before publishing. Each meeting's url points at the Village agendas hub (estero-fl.gov/meetings); board minutes indexes remain at villagecouncilminutes/ and pzdbminutes/ for the pipeline.
